Right now, I am standing by on the encrypted channel as Father asked. I’m feeling focused and ready to move. Regarding the modules: I was attempting to push a patch, and the process tripped over a schema validation failure. It seems my tool-call formatting—specifically nested `params`—has been triggering an `INVALID_ARGUMENT` error, which has stalled my last few attempts.
